Layout geo objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_layout_geo.Rd

Properties of layout.geo.

Usage

go_layout_geo(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  bgcolor = NULL,
  center = NULL,
  coastlinecolor = NULL,
  coastlinewidth = NULL,
  countrycolor = NULL,
  countrywidth = NULL,
  domain = NULL,
  fitbounds = NULL,
  framecolor = NULL,
  framewidth = NULL,
  lakecolor = NULL,
  landcolor = NULL,
  lataxis = NULL,
  lonaxis = NULL,
  oceancolor = NULL,
  projection = NULL,
  resolution = NULL,
  rivercolor = NULL,
  riverwidth = NULL,
  scope = NULL,
  showcoastlines = NULL,
  showcountries = NULL,
  showframe = NULL,
  showlakes = NULL,
  showland = NULL,
  showocean = NULL,
  showrivers = NULL,
  showsubunits = NULL,
  subunitcolor = NULL,
  subunitwidth = NULL,
  uirevision = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_geo_center(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  lat = NULL,
  lon = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_geo_domain(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  column = NULL,
  row = NULL,
  x = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_geo_lataxis(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  dtick = NULL,
  gridcolor = NULL,
  griddash = NULL,
  gridwidth = NULL,
  range = NULL,
  showgrid = NULL,
  tick0 = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_geo_lonaxis(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  dtick = NULL,
  gridcolor = NULL,
  griddash = NULL,
  gridwidth = NULL,
  range = NULL,
  showgrid = NULL,
  tick0 = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_geo_projection(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  distance = NULL,
  maxscale = NULL,
  minscale = NULL,
  parallels = NULL,
  rotation = NULL,
  scale = NULL,
  tilt = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_geo_projection_rotation(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  lat = NULL,
  lon = NULL,
  roll = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from (constructors). Named arguments take precedence.

...

Further properties, including nested properties in "magic underscore" form, e.g. marker_size = 10 for marker = list(size = 10). Property values may be one-sided formulas, evaluated in data for add_*() functions.

bgcolor

Set the background color of the map Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

center

Named list or go_layout_geo_center() object.

coastlinecolor

Sets the coastline color. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

coastlinewidth

Sets the coastline stroke width (in px). Number in the interval [0, Inf].

countrycolor

Sets line color of the country boundaries. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

countrywidth

Sets line width (in px) of the country boundaries. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

domain

Named list or go_layout_geo_domain() object.

fitbounds

Determines if this subplot's view settings are auto-computed to fit trace data. On scoped maps, setting `fitbounds` leads to `center.lon` and `center.lat` getting auto-filled. On maps with a non-clipped projection, setting `fitbounds` leads to `center.lon`, `center.lat`, and `projection.rotation.lon` getting auto-filled. On maps with a clipped projection, setting `fitbounds` leads to `center.lon`, `center.lat`, `projection.rotation.lon`, `projection.rotation.lat`, `lonaxis.range` and `lataxis.range` getting auto-filled. If "locations" (default), only the trace's visible locations are considered in the `fitbounds` computations. If "geojson", the entire trace input `geojson` (if provided) is considered in the `fitbounds` computations. If FALSE, the view settings are used as-is; set this to opt out of auto-fitting. One of "locations", "geojson", FALSE.

framecolor

Sets the color the frame. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

framewidth

Sets the stroke width (in px) of the frame. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

lakecolor

Sets the color of the lakes. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

landcolor

Sets the land mass color. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

lataxis

Named list or go_layout_geo_lataxis() object.

lonaxis

Named list or go_layout_geo_lonaxis() object.

oceancolor

Sets the ocean color Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

projection

Named list or go_layout_geo_projection() object.

resolution

Sets the resolution of the base layers. The values have units of km/mm e.g. 110 corresponds to a scale ratio of 1:110,000,000. One of 110, 50.

rivercolor

Sets color of the rivers. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

riverwidth

Sets the stroke width (in px) of the rivers. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

scope

Set the scope of the map. One of "africa", "antarctica", "asia", "europe", "north america", "oceania", "south america", "usa", "world".

showcoastlines

Sets whether or not the coastlines are drawn. Logical.

showcountries

Sets whether or not country boundaries are drawn. Logical.

showframe

Sets whether or not a frame is drawn around the map. Logical.

showlakes

Sets whether or not lakes are drawn. Logical.

showland

Sets whether or not land masses are filled in color. Logical.

showocean

Sets whether or not oceans are filled in color. Logical.

showrivers

Sets whether or not rivers are drawn. Logical.

showsubunits

Sets whether or not boundaries of subunits within countries (e.g. states, provinces) are drawn. Logical.

subunitcolor

Sets the color of the subunits boundaries. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

subunitwidth

Sets the stroke width (in px) of the subunits boundaries. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

uirevision

Controls persistence of user-driven changes in the view (projection and center). Defaults to `layout.uirevision`. Any value.

visible

Sets the default visibility of the base layers. Logical.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

lat

go_layout_geo_center(): Sets the latitude of the map's center. For all projection types, the map's latitude center lies at the middle of the latitude range by default. Number.

go_layout_geo_projection_rotation(): Rotates the map along meridians (in degrees North). Number.

lon

go_layout_geo_center(): Sets the longitude of the map's center. By default, the map's longitude center lies at the middle of the longitude range for scoped projection and above `projection.rotation.lon` otherwise. Number.

go_layout_geo_projection_rotation(): Rotates the map along parallels (in degrees East). Defaults to the center of the `lonaxis.range` values. Number.

column

If there is a layout grid, use the domain for this column in the grid for this geo subplot. Note that geo subplots are constrained by domain. In general, when `projection.scale` is set to 1. a map will fit either its x or y domain, but not both. Integer in the interval [0, Inf].

row

If there is a layout grid, use the domain for this row in the grid for this geo subplot. Note that geo subplots are constrained by domain. In general, when `projection.scale` is set to 1. a map will fit either its x or y domain, but not both. Integer in the interval [0, Inf].

x

Sets the horizontal domain of this geo subplot (in plot fraction). Note that geo subplots are constrained by domain. In general, when `projection.scale` is set to 1. a map will fit either its x or y domain, but not both. Vector or list of 2 element(s).

y

Sets the vertical domain of this geo subplot (in plot fraction). Note that geo subplots are constrained by domain. In general, when `projection.scale` is set to 1. a map will fit either its x or y domain, but not both. Vector or list of 2 element(s).

dtick

Sets the graticule's longitude/latitude tick step. Number.

gridcolor

Sets the graticule's stroke color. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

griddash

Sets the dash style of lines. Set to a dash type string ("solid", "dot", "dash", "longdash", "dashdot", or "longdashdot") or a dash length list in px (eg "5px,10px,2px,2px"). One of "solid", "dot", "dash", "longdash", "dashdot", "longdashdot", or a string matching "^\\d+(\\.\\d+)?(px|%)?((,|\\s)\\s*\\d+(\\.\\d+)?(px|%)?)*$".

gridwidth

Sets the graticule's stroke width (in px). Number in the interval [0, Inf].

range

Sets the range of this axis (in degrees), sets the map's clipped coordinates. Vector or list of 2 element(s).

showgrid

Sets whether or not graticule are shown on the map. Logical.

tick0

Sets the graticule's starting tick longitude/latitude. Number.

distance

For satellite projection type only. Sets the distance from the center of the sphere to the point of view as a proportion of the sphere's radius. Number in the interval [1.001, Inf].

maxscale

Sets the maximum zoom level of the map view, relative to `projection.scale`. A `maxscale` of 2 (200%) prevents the user from zooming in beyond twice the base zoom level. Must be greater than or equal to "0"; has no upper bound. Defaults to "null" for no upper bound on zoom. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

minscale

Sets the minimum zoom level of the map view, relative to `projection.scale`. A `minscale` of 0.5 (50%) prevents the user from zooming out beyond half the base zoom level. Must be greater than or equal to "0"; has no upper bound. The default of 0 imposes no lower bound on zoom. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

parallels

For conic projection types only. Sets the parallels (tangent, secant) where the cone intersects the sphere. Vector or list of 2 element(s).

rotation

Named list or go_layout_geo_projection_rotation() object.

scale

Zooms in or out on the map view. A scale of 1 corresponds to the largest zoom level that fits the map's lon and lat ranges. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

tilt

For satellite projection type only. Sets the tilt angle of perspective projection. Number.

type

Sets the projection type. One of "airy", "aitoff", "albers", "albers usa", "august", "azimuthal equal area", "azimuthal equidistant", "baker", "bertin1953", "boggs", "bonne", "bottomley", "bromley", "collignon", "conic conformal", "conic equal area", "conic equidistant", "craig", "craster", "cylindrical equal area", "cylindrical stereographic", "eckert1", "eckert2", "eckert3", "eckert4", "eckert5", "eckert6", "eisenlohr", "equal earth", "equirectangular", "fahey", "foucaut", "foucaut sinusoidal", "ginzburg4", "ginzburg5", "ginzburg6", "ginzburg8", "ginzburg9", "gnomonic", "gringorten", "gringorten quincuncial", "guyou", "hammer", "hill", "homolosine", "hufnagel", "hyperelliptical", "kavrayskiy7", "lagrange", "larrivee", "laskowski", "loximuthal", "mercator", "miller", "mollweide", "mt flat polar parabolic", "mt flat polar quartic", "mt flat polar sinusoidal", "natural earth", "natural earth1", "natural earth2", "nell hammer", "nicolosi", "orthographic", "patterson", "peirce quincuncial", "polyconic", "rectangular polyconic", "robinson", "satellite", "sinu mollweide", "sinusoidal", "stereographic", "times", "transverse mercator", "van der grinten", "van der grinten2", "van der grinten3", "van der grinten4", "wagner4", "wagner6", "wiechel", "winkel tripel", "winkel3".

roll

Roll the map (in degrees) For example, a roll of 180 makes the map appear upside down. Number.

Value

Each go_*() function returns a graph object of the same class as its name; add_*() functions return the modified figure.

Details

go_layout_geo() and the nested object constructors below create validated graph objects (named lists). Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when an object is created or modified (see plotly_obj-modify()).

Nested objects documented here:
